analysis.original_request:
我负责数据中心共封装光学模块中的硅微光学耦合元件。模块需要兼容 1260-1360 nm 和 1530-1565 nm 两个通信波段，希望采用一套镀膜降低空气与硅界面的反射，减少不同波段单独设计镀膜的复杂度。请为硅元件的入射表面设计平面多层介质减反膜：空气入射、入射角 0 deg、非偏振 unpolarized，硅作为半无限出射基底；在上述两个波段分别尽可能降低平均反射率，并报告进入硅基底的透射率。膜层仅允许 Ta2O5 和 SiO2，总层数不超过 12 层。
单层膜厚（layer thickness）：20-400 nm。
请比较宽带与双波段匹配方案，利用真实光谱结果调整膜厚，给出两波段之间的性能折中及最终结构。评价范围是局部平面界面的功率反射与透射。
analysis.normalized_request_english: Design a planar multilayer dielectric anti-reflection coating on the input surface of a unspecified material element for data center co-packaged optics. The module must be compatible with 1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm communication bands. Use a single coating to reduce reflection at the unspecified material-unspecified material interface. Incidence: unspecified material, 0 deg, unpolarized. Substrate: semi-infinite unspecified material. Objective: minimize average reflectance in both bands and report transmittance into unspecified material. Materials: Ta2O5 and SiO2 only. Max layer count: 12. Single layer thickness: 20-400 nm. Compare broadband vs dual-band matching schemes, adjust thicknesses using spectral results, provide performance trade-offs and final structure. Evaluation scope: power reflectance and transmittance at local planar interface.
analysis.compatibility_reason: Request specifies planar isotropic layered media under plane-wave illumination within solver capabilities.
preferred_behaviors: low average reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band
low average reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band
suppressed_behaviors: high reflection in the specified bands
manufacturing_constraints: individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm
materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2
method_research_questions: trade-off between broadband and dual-band matching performance

validation_warnings: unrequested material assumptions were replaced with unspecified
unrequested numeric assumptions were replaced with unspecified
